identity.title: Offline Forecast Target to Native WP170 ResearchSample and OOS Membership Binding
identity.objective: Bind native diagnostic forecast targets to cold-verified WP170 ResearchSample/TemporalSplitManifest and immutable membership hashes, maintaining fully read-only registry, real-value refusal and no OOS run-evidence release.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert precisely the eight scoped paths. Preserve legacy fcsteval receipt cold verification and avoid any native WP170/PIT/source schema or registry changes; no changes to PR268, Lane B, Hermes, Gate C, providers or live trading.

api_matrix.reason: Native WP170 target-to-sample mapping and historical receipt verification only; no duplicate experiment framework or changes to protected/store paths.
